Game Overview

Dash Heroes: Labyrinth is a arcade title where dash through intricate labyrinths in this fast-paced 2D arcade adventure. Master the art of dashing in all four directions to navigate treacherous mazes, avoid deadly traps, and collect glimmering treasures. Choose your hero, strategize your path, and see how far your skills will take you!
